requirements.text: When the traction unit has come to a standstill, the driver shall be able to release the emergency brake.
After releasing the emergency brake ETCS will provide the supervision appertaining when roll away protection was initiated.
When usign more than one traction unit this function shall be disabled in all but the leading traction unit.
All data entered, received or indicated to the driver shall be recorded onboard.
All data shall be related to UTC (Universal Time Corrected) and a reference point.
Information shall be recorded to an accuracy which enables a clear view of the functioning of ETCS and way the traction unit has been driven.
Standardised output interfaces shall enable transmission of information recorded to other media for investigation.
Data to enable investigation of accidents need only be stored for at least 24 hours, and shall be very detailed.

The following information shall be recorded: any transition of Level and of operational status; the driver’s confirmation of transition to shunting; train supervision data and information received from national train control systems; actual speed; full service brake intervention; emergency brake intervention; applying the train trip function; selection of the override control; override of the route suitability function; isolation of on board ETCS equipment; data entered, recieved or indicaed to the driver.

requirements.section: Special Operations > Using multiple traction units
requirements.text: It shall be possible to use multiple traction units without isolating the ETCS trainborne equipment on traciton unit(s) with an in-operative cab.

requirements.section: Special Operations > Using multiple traction units
requirements.text: Information received shall not influence the traction unit(s) with in-operative cabs.

requirements.section: Special Operations > Using multiple traction units
requirements.text: The train trip function (4.6.12.) shall be suppressed in traction unit(s) with in-operative cabs.

requirements.section: Special Operations > Using tandem traction units
requirements.text: It shall be possible to use tandem traction units without isolating the ETCS trainborne equipment on the tandem traction unit.

requirements.section: Special Operations > Using tandem traction units
requirements.text: The train trip function (4.6.12.) shall be suppressed on the tandem traction unit.
